explanation: The July 2, 2025 escalation (88412, Tier 2, Door 6 BOL scanner freeze) was corrected from the ambiguous "TP" / erroneous "Tansley Packaging" to Tansleigh Packaging (TSP), not Tansley Parcel (TPCL). The signed 2025 order also uses TP as Tansleigh's code, which is why the shorthand was ambiguous.
